column1: # defines each jobs-client function: `module<TAB>function`, one per line, as the
# single MAP heredoc in tests/jobs-client-modules.bh-1194-test.sh held them when
# Lane E split it into fragments (2026-09-24). Do NOT append here: a change that
# adds a client function writes its OWN tests/jobs-client-modules.d/<TICKET-KEY>.tsv,
# so two PRs never edit the same line (the old map kept every queue function on
# ONE line, and every queue verb a PR added conflicted with every other).
# Module order is the order of first appearance across the fragments in C name
# order — this file first — and must equal the shim's literal JC_MODULES line.
